answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 146922 Country: india Title: Please give me a wazifah/tasbih/dhikr for barakah in rizq and wealth. How many times it has to be recited and also the best time to recite it. Question: Please give me a wazifah/tasbih/dhikr for barakah in rizq and wealth. How many times it has to be recited and also the best time to recite it. Answer ID: 146922 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 315/286/L=3/1438) Recite Ya Mughni ( يا مغني ) 1111 times after Isha with durood 11-11 times before and after for prosperity and blessing in rizq (livelihood). And after Maghrib salah recite surah Waqiya and ask your family members as well to recite the same. In-shaAllah, it shall bring prosperity and blessings in rizq . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
